Name: CP - Cinder Crystalarium
Author: lesbianpinkie
Description:
This is a small, simple Content Patcher content pack that modifies the item type of Cinder Shards to be minerals (rather than "resources"). This allows you to put them in the Crystalarium. If you want more advanced custom Crystalarium behaviour check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2516]Custom Crystalariums[/url]﻿

Note: Any existing stacks of Cinder Shards you own will still be "Resources". You can fix this by taking one item off the stack, then putting the rest of the stack onto that item. This should transform them into "Minerals"
